title: Avomi FLIQ Prefilled Vape Pods - Cherry Ice
description: The Avomi Fliq 4-in-1 Replacement Prefilled Pods in Cherry Ice flavour offer a sweet and refreshing cherry flavour with a cool, icy finish for a satisfying vape. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, ensuring a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. Compatible with the Avomi Fliq 4-in-1 Prefilled Pod Device, these pods are designed for unparalleled ease of use no matter your previous experience with vaping. Just remove and dispose of the previous pod and click a new on into place. The device allows users to switch between four prefilled pods, offering a versatile and flexible vaping experience. With a rechargeable 950mAh battery and USB-C fast charging, the Avomi Fliq 4-in-1 device is both convenient and reusable. The ergonomic design and soft-touch coating ensure a comfortable grip for easy all-day use. The Avomi Fliq 4-in-1 Replacement Prefilled Pods allow you to easily change flavours to match your mood or preference, with over 25 unique flavours to choose from in the Avomi collection.
